plates.prompt: Create a finished 16:9 Roblox game promotional banner for 99 Planets To Defend in the established Painted-Anime-Inkline art style: richly painted anime environment, strong black contour, crisp colored cel shadows, whimsical atmosphere plus comic grit, polished illustrative detail, no full-frame hatch or blur. Reference 1 is the EXACT mascot identity to keep: gray alien/deer hybrid with huge pear/heart-shaped Gray alien head, huge shiny BLACK ALMOND-SHAPED slanted alien eyes with NO white eye rings, short round gray muzzle and small black nose, extremely elongated vertical oval OPEN BLACK MOUTH, gray pointed deer ears, branching CHARCOAL ANTLERS, thin long gray humanoid body, long arms and articulated elongated claw fingers, broad bare gray feet. Do not turn it back into a brown deer or change it to the reference banner's white-eyed deer. Reference 2 supplies composition only: giant mascot looming centrally behind two blocky Roblox players, arms stretching over them, frightened defenders fleeing over a fallen log, close wide-angle action. New original Worldheart setting: modern Earth forest edge outside a small suburban defense outpost at night, mint Worldheart crystal seen small behind log, far violet portal and deep blue wooded hills, floating motes, moonlight and warm lantern accents. Foreground two iconic block-proportioned Robloxian defenders: tousled orange-haired agent dark teal jacket and white block hands holding a red rescue axe diagonally; blonde defender mauve trousers holding a compact mint plasma carbine looking back worried. Keep faces readable and block shapes, don't make realistic human bodies. Gray mascot huge upper central framing, the entire iconic head/antlers and long fingers clear. Painted texture lives in surfaces; strongly readable thumbnail silhouettes and a suspenseful goofy adventure tone. No blood, no gore, no text, no logos, no watermark. Landscape wide banner.

plates.prompt: Create a finished 16:9 promotional gameplay-concept banner for 99 Planets To Defend, using EXACT mascot from reference1 and scene composition from reference2. Painted-Anime-Inkline: Studio Ghibli-like lush painted terrain and soft atmospheric light, Borderlands-like decisive dark contours, colored cel shadows and sharp handpainted surface detail; Roblox block-bodied player characters. Subject identity MUST stay gray alien/deer hybrid: giant pear-shaped smooth gray alien skull, very large BLACK ALMOND eyes slanting up, small round gray muzzle with BLACK nose, enormous elongated vertical OVAL black open mouth, gray pointed ears, branching charcoal antlers, thin humanoid gray torso, extremely long gray arms with four long articulated claw fingers, two gray legs, gray feet. No white googly deer eyes, no brown fur, no shirt/armor. Composition: elevated third-person/isometric game view overlooking a simple player-built semicircle of tall pointed timber stakes, central narrow gateway with three rows of bright steel barbed wire, five open steel jaw traps in a readable line before gateway. The Gray mascot towers behind the fence gap, leaning forward with both long hands reaching toward the gateway, clearly visible full face/antlers, upper body and legs. Two block-proportioned Robloxian defenders stand at lower-left and lower-right in wary ready poses pointing compact spears/plasma lances toward mascot; orange-haired dark-teal agent on left, red-haired blue-jacket player on right. Green painted meadow ground with little flowers, rocks and trampled path; a small modern field-defense outpost with mint energy supply details and subtle distant violet breach, believable Earth 2029 camping/defense construction. Background deep dark forest green so gray mascot and bright grass contrast; warm evening edge light, mint reflected light, suspenseful goofy survival adventure tone. Keep layout crystal clear at thumbnail size. Crisp illustration, not raw primitive 3D render. No extra enemies, no blood, no gore, no text, no logo, no watermark.
